context: Sho-young plays a board game with Naoko; competitive moment.
purpose: Aunt and child sharing playful game.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 翔、わし、本気で打ち合うで!
lines.en: Sho, I'm playing for real this time!
lines.style: Bright, animated Kansai warmth. Leans in conspiratorially, playful glint. Quick attack on the opening. Expectant, like she's daring him to keep up.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, eager voice climbing with excitement. Alert and focused. Quick-paced determination. The kind of earnest that makes adults smile.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: こっちのコマ、集めるで!
lines.style: Decisive, firm Kansai lilt. Sharp attack on the strategy. A little louder now—she's in it. Warm but no nonsense: she means to win.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夢中になっちゃう、面白い!
lines.style: Soft, absorbed voice. Wonder and contentment underneath. Slightly slower, dreamy. Lost in the game now, speaking half to himself.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 抑えるの、難しいで、わしを!
lines.en: It's hard to hold back, you know—me!
lines.style: Animated, self-aware laugh underneath. Kansai warmth with a touch of mock-complaint. Quick, playful self-deprecation. She's testing whether he can match her energy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 止めることできない、勝つで!
lines.en: I can't stop—I'm going to win!
lines.style: Bright, determined small voice. Quick pace, no hesitation. Fresh surge of confidence. The absolute certainty of a child in full focus.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ふふ、当たるか、逆転やな!
lines.en: Heh—looks like this might turn around!
lines.style: Warm, delighted Kansai chuckle on the opening. Playful recognition of the shift. Soft and alive—she's enjoying this more than any outcome.
